item.title: Determining the Exchange Rate: Purchasing Power Parity – PPP
item.description: This study aimed to examine the effect of inflation on the issue of exchange rate determination of the forward exchange rate on the exchange rate of RMB (Renminbi) to Rupiah. Inflation has been chosen as an independent variable because of its close relation to PPP (purchasing power parity) theory.
